title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — 家を借りる (Renting a Home in Japan)
description: From NHK Web やさしい日本語. Covers renting an apartment in Japan: property listing vocabulary (間取り、築年数、礼金、敷金), talking to a real estate agent, understanding a rental contract, and setting up utilities. Also explains uniquely Japanese conventions like guarantors (保証人) and key money (礼金).
creator: NHK (日本放送協会)
